cohort_history: Tan labels were used in prior fixed-grid Wave5; not held-out confirmation.

grouping.basis: Connected components of all current loci sharing any admitted TU ID, projected through exact current or native old-locus crosswalk; also union rows sharing a source locus. Unmapped source loci form separate groups. Build before scores.
grouping.join: Only current_locus_tag/RefSeq_locus_tag or old_locus_tag/legacy_locus_tag; require one distinct target with matching replicon and strand. Never names, donor orthologs, proximity or correction of aliases.
grouping.limitation: Source membership is partial, unordered and inferred, not experimentally verified operon or statistical independence.

io.output: sorted keys, indent2, ensure_ascii, allow_nan false, trailing LF; no-clobber atomic publication; failures exit2 and leave no new final output

primary.missing: empty or NA source count -> missing, never zero; invalid or nonfinite or negative numeric input fails
primary.response: arithmetic mean of both finite nonnegative source-reported replicate counts; both required; no library-size renormalization
primary.statistic: Spearman correlation, average ranks for ties

primary_comparison.control_predictor: ecoli_model_Tx_rate at offset_nt=0, paired mononucleotide-shuffled arm
primary_comparison.interpretation: synthetic composition control; not biological negatives or false-positive rate
primary_comparison.statistic: native rho minus shuffled rho on identical eligible rows

report_gate.accounting: All source rows, every exclusion reason, selected requests, condition/replicate missingness, endpoint denominators and group sizes retained; never treat model failure as zero.
report_gate.mode: Atomic complete original runner only; exact expected selected roster, order, sequences, native coordinate maps and deterministic controls; no partial-run estimates.
report_gate.numeric_validation: Finite JSON numbers, no bool-as-number; strictly positive model rates and finite energies; all41 offsets retained in each arm, unique contiguous -20..20; duplicate keys/nonfinite JSON rejected.
report_gate.reference_identity: Caller supplies exact SHA256 of report and prepared input artifact; never inferred or overwritten.

runner.model_host: Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655

secondary.contrasts: source log2FC/padj not analyzed; static sequence model cannot predict condition changes
secondary.uncertainty: point estimates only; descriptive, no multiple-testing or significance claims

families: TU membership state: membership-observed, source-membership-empty, unresolved-source-link, no-source-data, mapping-unavailable
same-strand predicted terminator intersects associated current CDS: observed, none-in-complete-coverage, coverage-incomplete, not-applicable, mapping-unavailable
strata.no_adjustment: Stratification only; no fitted regression, weighting, significance-based choice, causal confounder removal or model changes.
strata.statistics: native and shuffled rho and difference, point estimates only
strata.terminator_definition: Use mapped-locus cdsOverlap.sameStrandCallIds; observed takes precedence even if coverage partial. Zero counts require complete coverage. Not a transcript termination or between-TSS/CDS assertion.

target: Association of E. coli model anchor rates with source-reported native UTEX gTSS counts; no absolute-strength or causal claim.

uncertainty.invalid_draws: Track requested/valid/undefined; undefined constant/too-small draws excluded explicitly; fewer than 90% valid means null interval. Point estimates retained when defined.
uncertainty.method: Resample sorted input-only groups with replacement, same number of groups; retain all rows in each sampled group; recalculate average ranks each draw. Same draw for both arms.
uncertainty.quantile: linear interpolation at (n-1)*p over valid draws
